q2_gaps: frequency adverb ('regularly') on an imperative: the frequency-adverb strength bands and their QuantifierPhrase companion are defined only for a generic/habitual clause (the companion needs kind + verb-lemma arguments), Every/TimesPer require a stated period or rate, and a Directive's STV carries directive force rather than frequency, so nothing can carry 'regularly'
notes: Imperative sealing, the coordinated-VP split into two Directives, the definite-plural group witness, and top-level typing of the projected definite referents all follow the instruction set. One structural hazard worth recording: (PartOf sk_exterior_1 sk_group_1) reuses PartOf's member-of-group sense, so any later per-member distribution rule ranging over (PartOf $x sk_group_1) would bind the exterior as though it were a cabinet.
